name: Hyderabad Metropolitan Development Authority
summary: The planning authority for greater Hyderabad, which built the city's Outer Ring Road.
about: HMDA plans development across the Hyderabad region and builds the infrastructure that crosses local boundaries. Its largest road project is the 158 km Outer Ring Road, an eight-lane access-controlled ring around the city built through a special purpose company, Hyderabad Growth Corridor Limited. The ring road pulled long-distance traffic out of the city and set the shape of Hyderabad's growth over the last two decades.
facts: Built Hyderabad's 158 km eight-lane Outer Ring Road.
The ring road was built through a special company, Hyderabad Growth Corridor Limited.
Plans land use and infrastructure across the wider Hyderabad region.
